description: The RxRx1 outcomes and confirmatory results had already been accessed. This amendment prospectively fixes only the requested Rosenbaum sensitivity calculation and stable persistence diagnostic before those extension results are computed; it does not relabel either extension as confirmatory.

persistence_diagnostic.filtration: lower-star filtration of the four-neighbour pixel grid on the normalized nuclear channel
persistence_diagnostic.perturbation_distribution: independent uniform noise on [-epsilon, epsilon], followed by clipping to [0,1]
tests: exact equality of canonical arrays and persistence diagrams under the recorded treatment-dependent lattice action
empirical bottleneck distance no greater than the realized sup-norm perturbation
sup-norm no greater than Euclidean distance recovered from the Gaussian RKHS metric

rosenbaum_sensitivity.model: conditional independence of the eight paired assignment bits, with each assignment probability pi_b in [1/(1+Gamma), Gamma/(1+Gamma)]
rosenbaum_sensitivity.tail_event: unbiased squared MMD at least the observed value, with numerical tolerance 1e-12
rosenbaum_sensitivity.worst_case_calculation: enumerate all 2^8 assignment vectors and all 2^8 vertices of the Rosenbaum probability box
